sequence.scope: Approved design/API before code; retained native RED/GREEN and final qualification receipts; shared targets and disk constraints. Recorded before independent source review.
Completed registered campaign, report and delivery claims only.

resolved_retained_failures: Mutable endpoint binding in integration test
Equivalent fixture modulo expression required by Clippy

review: Schema fitting is limited to supplied training. Literal fragments and raw primitive spans preserve exact lexical bytes, including duplicate keys and numeric/escape spellings; unsupported or drifting layouts remain literal. Fingerprints only index layouts; full fragment equality determines a match. Artifact count/size, record/slot/output and comparison-work limits bound parsing and matching.

Decode validates artifact identity/version, all record counts, indices, tokens, lengths and trailing bytes in a complete first pass before allocating the bounded final output. The second pass copies identical validated fragments and values; no received code or mutable decoder registry is introduced.

Dictionary artifacts are bounded and require a trained-dictionary identifier. The pinned zstd loader validates tables; strict single-frame, declared-output-size, checksum and window validation remain enforced. Endpoint admission accounts for artifact, encoded input, output and decoder allowance before artifact loading.

New wire modes require an artifact base and forbid a manifest. Chunk length/count/aggregate bounds are independently enforced before appending. Artifact lookup stays in the authorized namespace. Existing replay/epoch/cancellation paths are reused, authorization is rechecked, and exact output length/digest are verified before durable publication.

Both explicit senders compare the complete successful-miss candidate framing cost against Raw and prefer Raw on ties/expansion. Candidate parsing/compression and discarded-work CPU remain inside timing. Invalid artifacts and missing remote bases are errors; no implicit retry or decoder substitution is added. Existing adaptive and coupled-runtime selectors do not silently opt into the prototype.

The benchmark freezes 512 training samples independently of 80 held-out target fixtures, fits once, uses the same training slices for an 8192-byte trained-zstd dictionary, and compares five real client/endpoint paths. Record-sized and whole-record approximately 1 MiB batches include lexical/layout variation, drift and unrelated bytes. Ordinary zstd versus dictionary differences include framing/window effects, explicitly disclosed with the whole-prefix adaptive control.

Each target is compared after closing/reopening the store. Three learned/base arms seed explicitly even on later Raw fallback. Fit/training plus serialization, all destination seeds, actual 80-use amortization and per-trial cold sums remain distinct. Total process CPU counts sender and receiver once; nested exchange/receiver scopes are not added again. Both directions' serialized body-equivalent bytes are counted. Failures preserve observations and owned stores.
limits: The initial source review preceded measurement. The later bounded results-consistency check validates the completed registered local campaign and its reported limitations; it does not establish a general performance guarantee.
One registered local campaign completed: 400 target transfers plus 240 seeds, with all results and negative cases retained. No new WAN, packet-total, energy, MVM or compliance claim follows.
Coverage is focused, with no branch or whole-repository coverage claim; two historical tests remain explicitly ignored.
Template support is intentionally flat primitive JSON; arbitrary input is preserved via literal/Raw fallback, which can still consume attempted-codec CPU and prior artifact-seeding cost.
The reviewer used existing tests/build receipts and source inspection; no new test, build, experiment, analyzer or archive was added.

results_review.method: One bounded inline JSON consistency calculation over the existing raw rows, plan and summary; no new test, build, measurement, analyzer project or archive.
confirmed: 640 exact reopened operations (400 targets and 240 seeds), zero reported errors, and 400 unique successful cleanup joins
All 80 target identities and lengths match the registered plan across the five arms; seed identities match their fitted artifact or training corpus
Both directional byte totals and total >= exchange >= receiver CPU hold for every operation; sender CPU equals total minus exchange
All 40 cell medians/minima/maxima/p95 and per-trial cold sums match raw observations; all five actual 80-use totals and amortized costs match raw operations plus one fit
Registration, source map, plan, raw JSONL, summary, frozen executable and stored training/artifact hashes match their pins; implementation/harness/tests remain unchanged from reviewed source
results_review.interpretation: Report and delivery/ledger/direction/README claims are appropriately conditional and local. Schema loses to conventional compression on this workload. Dictionary improves seeded small-record bytes but has higher CPU, cold cost and total mixture cost than ordinary zstd. Cold means an initially unfitted sender plus a new destination, not retraining for every destination. Actual 80-use totals count one fitting cost and 80 actual seeds; receiver reuse was not measured.
